_comment: Starter experiment — an EXAMPLE of shape, not a recommendation for your business. Rewriting arms/hypotheses is part of engine-setup. The second arm ships with no template on purpose: first time it's assigned, the agent writes it from the hypothesis (R4). Optional fields per experiment: channel, direction, aggregate — see engine-loop/references/ab-testing.md.

arms.label: payoff first
arms.hypothesis: Leading with the result earns the first 1.5 seconds, which is the only part that matters.

arms.label: tension first
arms.hypothesis: Opening on the problem creates a gap the viewer wants closed, buying a longer watch. Risk: slower start loses people before the gap opens.
